title: Scoped negative result: copy-rank floor for two-sided P112 parity lifts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This is a **scoped negative result and adversarial audit**, with no new kappa. The fixed P112 two-sided parity-lift family cannot lower the separate-total copy-rank sum below 64 over all 512 character gates per side and arbitrary complex amplitudes. Members with columns outside the root code on both factors cost at least 76.

The proof reduces each amplitude to four exact support classes, then the certificate exhausts 4,194,304 gate-and-class records. Two binary-rank implementations agree on all 325638 support pairs. This is a computer-assisted finite result plus a written complex-amplitude reduction, not a formal proof of the full multiplication theorem or a barrier for arbitrary ten-term decoders.

The audit recovers our interrupted, unpublished seed-32 experiment. It fixes an invalid two-sided test precondition and adds an explicit accounting control: omitting both compensation-term charges would falsely report 62 for a cost-76 identity. The selected supplier is unaffected.

## Task and overlap

OS assignment seed **68**, adversarial audit. Exact base **bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f**. The claim records three candidate obligations and the selected scope. The original experiment's coordinate pair `(0,5)` is retained; changing the audit seed is not presented as a new search.

The new result concerns orthogonal two-sided rank-one updates, all binary character gates and the complete complex-amplitude support classes. PR845 and PR1197 retain coordinate readers; PR1224 already supplies a ten-term two-sided example. This submission credits that existence result and adds the stated cost census. PR1133's rational-descent scope is also retained. Exact predecessor heads and source hashes are recorded in `SOURCES.json`.

The final refresh covered 813 open PRs and 64 discussion records with complete reported pagination. Nearby PR1304, PR1313, PR1320, PR1323 and Discussion1316 investigate different fixed-frame, masked or support-trimming families. No pinned coordination issue exists, so the claim is local.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p112-parity-lift-audit-seed68/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_P112_PARITY_LIFT_AUDIT_S68 records=4194304 minimum=64 rank_cap=8 independent_pairs=325638`.

Passed on CPython 3.14.8 and optimized CPython 3.11.17. The package has 27 literal identity cases, eleven embedded controls, and a relocated package test rejecting modified receipts, source bytes and Git-blob pins. Selected-record integrity also passes. See `VALIDATION.md` for commands and observed boundaries.

Preparation, source access, frames, restoration and recursive children were granted zero expense for the copy-component screen. No full supplier recurrence, new rank moment or physical construction is supplied. The physical interpretation inherits separate-total gathering and copy-tree assumptions. Full selected cold replay, package-specific Linux/hosted execution and formalization were not run.

Credit Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled, DreamingOfClouds, Mihir Srivastava, joaqcoo, mightyOil and the retained lineage. Prepared for Sagar Thakrar (@thakrarsagar) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. All changes are confined to one new research package; `upstream/` and the selected frontier are unchanged.
